'''House Alde''' was the estate of the noble [[House Alde]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]], it was just north of [[Fort Alde]], and contained the [[Royal Museum of Alderaan]].
